title: narcissus asturiensis subsp. jacetanus
intro: Narcissus asturiensis subsp. jacetanus, commonly known as the Asturian narcissus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus asturiensis subsp. jacetanus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
